title: 第9章 山君伥鬼红坊村第10章 银子开路使用功法
slug: 全民高塔开局一个神话天赋
lines: 情况出乎意料地好......
吴语露出笑容，点头道：“几位兄弟一看就是正气凛然的人，实不相瞒......我和恶虎山寨不共戴天！”
看他一副愤怒的样子，几人面面相觑，
持枪士兵好奇道：“莫非你也是被恶虎山寨劫了的人？”
“正是！”
吴语想到刘宇在里边，故作感叹。
“说起来我们一行人被山贼攻击，也不知能活下来几个。”
“那你运气不错。”
几个披甲村民露出同情之色，
其中一人笑道：“总之来了红坊村就安全了，那些山贼可不敢接近这边！你们有人已经先来一步，待会儿你估计可以见到他们。”
“不过同情归同情，规矩不能废！”
“外乡人，请念一句话！”
“什么话？”
吴语问道。
“山君山君！杂种一只！”
持枪男子开口。
吴语心头一动，想到恶虎山寨几个字，这句话莫非有什么关联？
他也没有犹豫，果断念了一句。
见他念得这么自然，几个村民都松了口气。
“我说嘛，没必要这么紧张！”
持枪村民笑道：“这位兄弟没有穿恶虎山贼的服装，肯定是没有经过山君仪轨的！”
“不当伥鬼和小人，那肯定只是倒霉蛋一个！”
说笑间，几人将栅栏开启，让吴语走了进去。
听着他们的交流，吴语心中惊奇。
山君仪轨，伥鬼，小人......
这个【新人秘境】，隐藏的秘密恐怕比他想象的还要多！
进入谷内，立刻有一个壮硕大汉快步过来。
他身披铁甲，眼神冷漠。
“哼！又是一个外乡人！”
“我警告你！来红坊村休整我们欢迎，小偷小摸不可以！”
听着大汉带着怒气的话语，吴语眉头微皱，有些疑惑地看向一旁的持枪村民。
后者无奈，只能介绍道：“这位是我们红坊村的护卫队长，卢队长！”
content_en:
Things are going surprisingly well...
Wu Yu showed a smile, nodded and said: "These brothers are righteous people at first glance, and I can't hide it...Evil Tiger Village and I are inseparable!"
Seeing his angry look, several people looked at each other.
The gun-wielding soldier asked curiously: "Could it be that you were also robbed by the Evil Tiger Village?"
"Exactly!"
Wu Yu thought that Liu Yu was inside and pretended to sigh.
"Speaking of which, our group was attacked by bandits. I don't know how many of us will survive."
"Then you're in luck."
Several armored villagers showed sympathy.
One of them smiled and said: "Anyway, it's safe when you come to Hongfang Village. Those bandits don't dare to approach here! Some of you have already come first, and you can probably see them later."
"But sympathy is sympathy, and the rules cannot be abolished!"
"Stranger, please read a word!"
"What words?"
Wu Yu asked.
"Tiger Tiger! A bastard!"
The man with the gun spoke.
Wu Yu's heart suddenly moved as he thought of the words "Evil Tiger Village". Could there be any connection between these words?
He did not hesitate and recited decisively.
Seeing that he read it so naturally, several villagers breathed a sigh of relief.
"I'm telling you, there's no need to be so nervous!"
The villager holding the gun laughed and said: "This brother is not wearing the clothes of the evil tiger bandit, so he must not have gone through the tiger ritual!"
"If you're not a traitor or a villain, you're definitely just an unlucky guy!"
While they were joking, several people opened the fence and let Wu Yu walk in.
Listening to their exchange, Wu Yu was surprised.
Tiger rituals, ghosts, villains...
This [Newcomer Secret Realm] may contain more secrets than he imagined!
...
As soon as they entered the valley, a strong man walked over quickly.
He was wearing iron armor and had cold eyes.
"Huh! Another foreigner!"
"I'm warning you! We welcome you to come to Hongfang Village to rest, but petty theft is not allowed!"
"You guys..."
Listening to the angry words of the big man, Wu Yu frowned slightly and looked at the gun-wielding villagers aside with some confusion.
The latter had no choice but to introduce: "This is our guard captain of Hongfang Village, Captain Lu!"
title_en: Chapter 9 The Tiger and the Ghost in Hongfang Village Chapter 10 Yin Zi Opens the Road and Uses Kung Fu Techniques
